title: Check answer
description: The answer of the command check, on standard output, once the adapter has shown that its rights at the vendor and its settings work: offers, the machines the adapter can make with its settings. The adapter made no machine for it. A provisioner that uses the adapter claims only after a successful check, and sends the offers of the adapter's last successful check as the offers of each of its claims, https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/claim.schema.json. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it.

offers.description: The machines the adapter can make with its settings, in the order of its settings, 1 to 64 of them: for each, disk_gib is the largest disk the adapter gives that machine. Each is a machine_spec of the provisioner contract. When the settings contain more than 64 machines, or none, check fails with kind defect, check.schema.json.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /offers. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define, as it refuses a document that this schema refuses.
